item.title: Canada Leader Answers Trump's "Lake America" With Giant "Lake Ontario" Sign
item.description: Ontario Premier Doug Ford answered President Donald Trump's "Lake America" decree Saturday with a billboard-sized message on the Canadian shoreline - "Lake Ontario. Now and Always" - as Canadian leaders met the move with ridicule rather than outrage. Canada Leader Answers Trump's "Lake America" With Giant "Lake Ontario" Sign.

item.title: Nepal flood survivors return to ruins to salvage memories
item.description: The village of Dhunge, once home to roughly 150 families, now lies in ruins, reduced to a swampy expanse with an ominous rotting stench. one of dozens of settlements obliterated by the Himalayan floods. Nepal flood survivors return to ruins to salvage memories.

item.title: Humanitarian crisis worsening in refuge for civilians fleeing Sudan’s civil war
item.description: Conditions are deteriorating in city of El Obeid and camps on its outskirts, with more people arriving every dayHumanitarian conditions in the Sudanese city of El Obeid and two camps on its outskirts are dire and deteriorating, according to people on the ground, as civilians displaced by fighting between the Sudanese Armed Forces and Rapid Support Forces (RSF) militia continue to pour.

item.description: PM’s visit will focus on strengthening ties with Iran, Tajikistan, and other Central Asian countries; the agenda will include engagements aimed at the upcoming BRICS Summit in September, the two-year UN Security Council term of 2028-2029, and planning for the long-pending India-Central Asia Summit, which has not met since 2022 PM Modi’s SCO visit is loaded with expectations on BRICS Summit and UNSC election.

item.title: Zelenskyy Blasts 'Negligence' As Ukraine Mourns Dozens Killed In Russian Strike
item.description: Ukrainian rescue crews early on August 30 continued to search for victims of the deadly Russian attack outside of Kyiv, while local residents -- as well as President Volodymyr Zelenskyy -- demanded answers as to why explosives were stored in a warehouse so near private housing. Zelenskyy Blasts 'Negligence' As Ukraine Mourns Dozens Killed In Russian Strike.

item.title: Was it a mistake for 99 Colombian guerrillas to lay down their arms?
item.description: ‘Total peace’ plan of previous government led only 99 of Colombia’s 30,000 armed combatants to disarm, but new president Abelardo De la Espriella opposes peace agreementsIn mid-June, 99 guerrilla fighters were flown by helicopter to a small settlement in a rural area of southern Colombia where they lined up and, one by one, handed their weapons to government officials: rifles, pistols, machine gun.

item.title: Russia's 'Make Or Break' Airliner Approaches Production Amid Sanctions And Shortages
item.description: An "all-Russian" MC-21 passenger jet made its first test flight in early August, marking a step closer to full production, due to begin in 2027. But years of geopolitical turbulence have pushed the project far off-course, aviation insiders say. Russia's 'Make Or Break' Airliner Approaches Production Amid Sanctions And Shortages.
